title: Use a bow drill
kid_text: A grown-up pulls the bow back and forth.

steps.text: Tie a loose string on a bent stick.
Wrap that string once around the spindle.
Cut a notch in the hearth to the edge.
Pull the bow in long smooth strokes.
Tip the coal into the nest when it smokes.

mistakes.text: The string is so tight it will not move.
mistakes.fix: Loosen it until the spindle turns.
